Luna Introduces PROTECT Act to Safeguard Child Safety Online WASHINGTON, D.C.—Today, Congresswoman Anna Paulina Luna (FL-13) introduced the House companion bill to the Preventing Rampant Online Technological Exploitation and Criminal Trafficking (PROTECT) Act introduced by Senator Mike Lee (UT) last January in the United States Senate. This bill will require websites that host pornography to obtain age and identity verification of individuals uploading pornographic content.
